formalTerms.Agent: A formal Ordivon participant or cognition-bearing system role. Use lowercase agent for the generic category.
formalTerms.Task: A durable Ordivon work object. Use lowercase task when no exact schema object is intended.
formalTerms.Effect: An admitted external commitment. Do not use as a synonym for any action or result.
formalTerms.Artifact: A retained evidence-bearing output with identity. Use lowercase artifact generically.
formalTerms.Observation: A bounded recorded result. It is not equivalent to hidden world truth.
formalTerms.Verification: An explicit check against a declared contract. It is not a synonym for success.
formalTerms.READY: A readiness state only. It does not grant authority or prove correctness.
formalTerms.UNKNOWN: An operational uncertainty state, not a model feeling or missing prose.
formalTerms.canonical: The current source authorized to state a fact within a declared scope.
formalTerms.derived: A projection generated or written from canonical sources without becoming a second authority.

preferredPairs.runtime: Runtime only when referring to the formal Ordivon project or object; otherwise runtime
preferredPairs.provider: Provider only for an exact contract identity; otherwise provider
preferredPairs.world: World only for an authoritative Ordivon domain state; otherwise world
